observed_documentation: Meeting ID is the idempotency key, not a time cursor
Deterministic parser, identity filter, ledger and audit are distinct from LLM extraction
Unresolved person/company names remain unconfirmed in a reviewable vault
Source code and frequently changing generated vault are separate repos
cases.existing_ghostmesh: Scout tracks source IDs, revisions and uncertain contributor names; GhostMesh has distinct deterministic readers and model interpretation steps.
cases.specific_difference: A source-item identity checkpoint and explicit unresolved-entity queue avoid silently advancing past delayed transcripts.
cases.transfer_question: Would Scout's collector skip delayed or reappearing sources if using timestamps instead of immutable IDs?
cases.strongest_objection: A single-writer, Circleback-only meeting ingest pipeline is not a general distributed Scout collector; its correctness claims are README statements.
cases.minimum_test: Construct 12 offline out-of-order source events with delayed arrivals, duplicate IDs and ambiguous author names; compare timestamp-cursor and source-ID ledger behavior. Keep unresolved names unmerged.

observed_documentation: Explains repeated sandbox blocks and proposed narrow configuration edits
Requires a direct Allow or Deny review before applying a settings change
Refuses wildcard hosts and broad /tmp grants, according to documentation
cases.existing_ghostmesh: GhostMesh has owner-only execution authority, release approvals and strict secret boundaries.
cases.specific_difference: Operator-facing explanation of repeated blocked actions, their scope and reversible repair alternatives may reduce approval-loop confusion without silently increasing authority.
cases.transfer_question: Could a read-only diagnostic report explain repeated GhostMesh prompts and suggest scoped corrections while preserving explicit owner authorization?
cases.strongest_objection: The project is tailored to Claude Code's sandbox and proposed permission edits can increase attack surface; repeated blocks do not justify automatic grants.
cases.minimum_test: Use six synthetic permission-block receipts and produce operator-readable explanations and hypothetical reversible remedies; reject wildcards, credential access and any automatic grant.

observed_documentation: Electron PR client with grouping, cache and diff navigation
README describes multi-agent review and bulk PR actions
cases.existing_ghostmesh: GhostMesh already maintains review custody, owner approvals and source receipts.
cases.specific_difference: Navigation and grouping of concurrent reviews may improve operator throughput.
cases.transfer_question: Does a grouped queue reduce blocked-review retrieval time against GhostMesh's existing workflow?
cases.strongest_objection: No measured improvement, and bulk operations do not convey approval authority.
cases.minimum_test: Read-only six-PR fixture; compare retrieval and decision error rates without any merge action.

observed_documentation: JSON schema has model, metric, document, task and result data
Task-level and aggregate review includes human and algorithmic judgments
cases.existing_ghostmesh: Scout has source-revision, claim-impact, counterevidence and review status.
cases.specific_difference: Task- and annotator-level inspection may reveal errors hidden by aggregated scores.
cases.transfer_question: Can its schema carry Scout's source revisions and dissent without losing semantics?
cases.strongest_objection: Six-case mapping showed eight Scout fields requiring deliberate representation; full importer was not validated.
cases.minimum_test: Complete one private import fixture with explicit provenance fields; no external app installation.

observed_documentation: README describes summarizing GitHub changes across chosen date/release/label windows
Creates editable release notes and supports emailing subscribers
cases.existing_ghostmesh: Scout already records revision witnesses and changes and can prepare editorial views.
cases.specific_difference: Release-window editorial packaging could make source changes easier for humans to consume.
cases.transfer_question: Would structured release-window briefs improve readback beyond existing change logs?
cases.strongest_objection: Generated prose can conceal underlying changed-file evidence; external email integration is unnecessary and unauthorized.
cases.minimum_test: Summarize one retained read-only change witness and require links to exact changed files.

observed_documentation: README describes fuzzy text change comparison, optional AI summaries and Twilio SMS alerts
cases.existing_ghostmesh: Scout has revision witness and content diff prototypes.
cases.specific_difference: Broad website snapshots could extend collection where revisions are unavailable.
cases.transfer_question: Does fuzzy diffing identify meaningful edits with fewer false notifications?
cases.strongest_objection: This is a common polling/alert pattern; README setup includes credentials and optional external sends, neither needed for Scout research.
cases.minimum_test: Compare existing local content diff with fuzzy character edits on fixed offline pages.
